parameters.help_en: A unique token that is used to ensure idempotency. This token is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests. The token can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The release type. Valid values:

immediate: immediately deletes the instance. After deletion, the system permanently clears all data, and the instance no longer appears in the instance list.
protective: freezes the instance for 24 hours before permanently clearing the data. During this period, the instance still appears in the instance list. You can choose to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/202205.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160591.html
parameters.help_zh:
释放类型，可选值：

immediate：立即删除。删除后，系统会彻底清除所有数据，且实例不再显示在实例列表中。
protective：实例会被冻结24小时后，再彻底清除数据，期间实例仍在实例列表中显示，您可以选择https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/202205.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160591.html
parameters.name: delete_type
